primary_scope: Reset-inclusive resident clean request; warm service distinct from measured service
nested_subsets: backend quantization/kernel/copy/synchronization inside prefill/decode; counters are not durations
unmeasured_residual: Sampling full finite logits and greedy argmax, commit/EOG/cap, batch/output allocation and setup, physical metadata/counters, final sync gaps and timer overhead are not individually partitioned
exclusions: Model load/context provision occurs before service, with their own recorded timers in native result.json
Terminal full state export and semantic-tape/receipt serialization occur after service
Exact native lifetime is not measured: launch_to_exit_observation_s and exit_observed_monotonic_ns are filled after post-exit module/budget validation, beyond polling
phase1_main_to_result_s for measured is cumulative from process start, including warm request and earlier post-service work
limitations: No S2 operator-time stack is combined with these service times
Same-panel phase differences are descriptive and do not isolate quantization vs scalar dot vs launch costs
Single warm per fresh process is prescribed, not general steady-state evidence
Host caller totals include warm plus measured plus checks; do not add them to service sums
